# Prajeet the Creator

> Free scholarship guidance for Nepalese and international students applying to study in India. Covers ICCR, COMPEX, Study in India (SII), Mahatma Gandhi, Golden Jubilee, Homi J. Bhabha, and SAARC scholarships — with eligibility criteria, required documents, step-by-step application guides, deadline alerts, and free COMPEX exam practice tests.

## Scholarships
- [ICCR Scholarship](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/iccr-scholarship): Fully funded scholarship for international students to study in India — covers tuition, accommodation, and monthly stipend.
- [COMPEX Scholarship](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/compex-scholarship): Entrance-exam-based scholarship from the Embassy of India, Kathmandu, for Nepalese students (Engineering, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Food Technology, Nursing).
- [Study in India (SII)](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/study-in-india-sii): Government of India program covering 900+ institutions and 8000+ courses.
- [Mahatma Gandhi Scholarship Scheme](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/mahatma-gandhi-scholarship): Financial support for Nepalese Class 11-12 students studying in Nepal.
- [Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/golden-jubilee-scholarship): Financial assistance for Nepalese undergraduate students studying in Nepal.
- [Dr. Homi J. Bhabha Scholarship Scheme](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/homi-j-bhabha-scholarship): Postgraduate engineering (M.E./M.Tech.) scholarship for Nepalese nationals.
- [SAARC Scholarship (Hospitality & Hotel Management)](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/scholarships/saarc-hospitality-hotel-management-scholarship): B.Sc. Hospitality & Hotel Management scholarship for Nepalese students.

## Resources
- [Updates & Alerts](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/updates): Deadline reminders, embassy notices, and result announcements.
- [Document Guidance](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/documents): Sample formats for English-as-a-subject letters, translations, and physical fitness certificates.
- [COMPEX Exam Practice](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/compex-practice): Free full-length and subject-wise mock tests for the COMPEX entrance exam (Physics, Chemistry, English, Math/Biology).
- [About](https://www.prajeetthecreator.com/about): About Prajeet Shah, the creator of this site.
